_charlesabate_: On the way to R-C9, Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Night raid. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate helped stack spare sandbags at R-C9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
dr_doom12367: Casimir Doom walked into S-C14 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Casimir Doom stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
el.heffy000: Silas Heffy joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Silas Heffy was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R11. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous of the Hegemony (@krokous21). News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R11 with the rations. Silas Heffy ate while listening to the revised orders.
fenley_sam: Gideon Sam took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

An empty jam tin became Gideon Sam's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. Gideon Sam reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Gideon Sam fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Karel Jokinen, grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Gideon Sam looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close.
greedndreadnought34: Cyril Greedndreadn found a place in U-F6 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
kg1912ss: On Day 9, Bastian "Ghost" Kgss arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss left the work of a rifleman to become a sniper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Bastian "Ghost" Kgss was waiting. Dietrich Johnmetheny was grazed. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss wrote down the news without trying to explain it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Ghost" Kgss. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
matthew.ordaz12: Bram Ordaz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
nathan_hill2308: Lucien Hill was a coal miner in Brennmoor until the posters went up. He came to R-C11 with a child's drawing of a horse, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Lucien Hill wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
rybilton: Florian "Ash" Rybilton reached P-F20 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
travismac78: "You're late," said the corporal when Albin Travismac arrived on Day 3. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Albin Travismac saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

The salvo walked along S-F5 and caught Albin Travismac in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos. A letter from home reached Albin Travismac before dusk. Albin Travismac read it twice and slept a little easier.

No bed for Albin Travismac yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Albin Travismac during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
There was never a bed for Albin Travismac, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F5 on his own feet.
Albin Travismac and Oskar Mitaylor split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Albin Travismac fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Roland Maccerny was grazed. Albin Travismac ate breakfast without a word.
A bullet hit Albin Travismac's belt buckle at S-F5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).

The medics cleaned Albin Travismac's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F5. Blackwater Canal has been won. Albin Travismac listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
